name: Noise Derivative FBM
aliases: Tweaked Fractal Brownian Motion using noise derivatives
definition: A technique to generate realistic-looking noise patterns for terrains by using the derivative between sampled points (representing steepness/rate of change) instead of just noise values, resulting in better-looking, more detailed terrains with steeper regions and flat plateaux.
summary: Noise Derivative FBM is a terrain generation technique using analytic noise derivatives to dampen height accumulation, creating detailed landscapes with steep regions and flat plateaux.
